name: Dynamic Serena 2-Person Full-Spectrum Infrared Sauna
description: Dynamic Serena 2-Person Full Spectrum Near-Zero EMF (Under 3 mg) FAR Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) Looking for a natural way to relax and recharge without leaving home? Dynamic Saunas are crafted from sustainable Canadian Hemlock wood, offering both durability and a clean, modern look. Equipped with energy-efficient Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels, they provide soothing warmth that helps reduce stress, ease muscle tension, and promote overall wellness. This sauna also features are newest Full Spectrum heating technology, MP3 Aux - Bluetooth capability, and Chromotherapy Lighting. Designed with versatility in mind, Dynamic Saunas can be installed in almost any indoor space from basements and master baths to walk-in closets or fitness rooms. Their compact design makes them easy to place, while their long-term health benefits make them an ideal addition to any lifestyle. With a Dynamic Sauna, you’re not just upgrading your home, you’re creating a personal sanctuary for daily renewal. Features: Near-zero EMF - EMF under 3 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels 2-person capacity 7 Total Heaters, 5 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF (EMF under 3 MG - 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels) FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels, 2 Near IR Elements Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Clear Tempered glass door Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System + Red Light Therapy Feature Interior LED Control Panels Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers 118F-132F is the deal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 140F Clasp together assembly Roof vent Ships in 2 boxes Note: Indoor use only Specifications: Sauna weight: 285 lbs. Shipping weight: 370 lbs. Electrical service: 120V/15amp Non GFCI plug & play (Recommended Dedicated Outlet) Exterior dimensions (LWH): 40″ x 46″ x 75″ Interior dimensions (LWH): 36″ x 42″ x 68″
